value.rationale: The precise change in optimal allocation under a heterogeneous price shock is an inherently relevant complete fixed-lattice design problem explicitly motivated as a future generalized cost direction in the foundational paper. A piecewise-global classification, two price-dependent optimal radii, a sharp crossover and its exact value-derivative jump inform how sensor footprints should change across different relative costs; the full phase law, not the known equal-price benchmark, is the substantive result.
